jobDescription: Key Responsibilities Review and audit legal invoices submitted by external law firms for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with client-approved billing guidelines. Analyze attorney time entries, staffing patterns, legal tasks, expenses, and billing narratives to identify excessive, redundant, or non-compliant charges. title: Sr Governance Lead (ISB / London Market Account)
jobDescription:
Why We Need This Role The account operates within a complex ISB governance environment, including: Formal deal governance forums (deal reviews, solution reviews) with strict submission criteria, approval thresholds, and cadence. Structured decision approval processes across demand, procurement, and headcount, involving multiple approval layers and stakeholders Requirement for traceability, compliance, and auditability of decisions and approvals across the account Without a dedicated governance lead, there is risk of: Missed or delayed approvals Poor submission quality Lack of visibility and audit trail Inconsistent processes across teams Key Accountabilities
1. ISB Governance Oversight (Core Accountability) Own and oversee governance across the account, ensuring alignment with ISB policies and processes Ensure full compliance with: Deal governance (Deal Reviews, Solution Reviews) Demand and approval processes Procurement and financial governance Act as the single point of coordination for governance-related activities
2. Sales Governance (Deal & Solution Reviews) Manage and coordinate submissions into ISB governance forums, including: Deal Review Forums Solution Review Forums Ensure: Submissions meet required criteria, thresholds, and timelines Materials are complete and of high quality prior to submission Track outcomes, approvals, and required follow-up actions ISB governance forums require structured submission processes, defined thresholds, and formal approvals prior to progression
3. Governance Model & Process Ownership Define, implement, and maintain a clear governance model across the account, covering: Decision approval processes Operations governance forums and cadence Submission processes and templates Standardise and improve governance processes to ensure: Consistency Efficiency Transparency
4. Decision Governance & Traceability Ensure all decisions and approvals are: Properly recorded Tracked Auditable Maintain and manage decision logs / approval trackers Provide visibility of decisions and status across stakeholders 👉 Current ISB processes emphasise centralised tracking and visibility of all approvals and decision outcomes
5. Business Reviews (MBR / QBR Support) Support monthly and quarterly business reviews Work with Finance and leadership to: Produce governance-aligned reporting Ensure data consistency and accuracy Provide structured updates on: Approvals and governance progress Risks and issues Compliance status
6. Cross-Functional Governance Coordination Work across: Sales (deal governance) Resource Management (HC approvals) Procurement (P.O.s, SOWs) Finance (affordability, approvals, reviews) Ensure all areas operate within a consistent governance framework Profile We Need This is a control and coordination leadership role, not just admin. Critical Skills Strong governance, process management, or PMO experience Understanding of structured approval processes and forums Strong ability to manage complex workflows and multiple stakeholders Excellent organisation and attention to detail Strong communication and follow-through capability Behavioural Attributes Highly structured and disciplined Proactive and control-oriented Strong accountability mindset Able to operate confidently with senior stakeholders Focused on quality, compliance, and consistency What Success Looks Like Near-Term All governance processes are: Clearly defined Consistently followed Properly documented High-quality, compliant submissions into ISB governance forums Full visibility of approvals, decisions, and status Longer-Term A fully embedded governance operating model across the account Improved approval timelines and reduced rework Strong confidence from leadership in governance and compliance At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. title: Analyst I Infrastructure Services
jobDescription:
The Share Point Online & Power Platform Support Engineer will provide stable, secure, and compliant operational support . The role is responsible for ensuring business continuity, platform governance, service stability, and user productivity across Share Point Online and Power Platform solutions used by distributed project teams, corporate functions, and site operations. The position requires strong technical troubleshooting capabilities, an understanding of Microsoft 365 governance, and the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, platform SMEs, Microsoft Support, and global delivery teams. Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Share Point Online Operational Support Provide technical and functional operational support for Share Point Online, including: Share Point sites and site collections Document libraries and lists Metadata, content types, and permissions Share Point groups and security controls Internal and external sharing Manage Share Point site lifecycle activities: Provisioning Configuration and modification Archival Decommissioning Troubleshoot issues related to: User access and permissions Site and library performance Search Document synchronization Version history Content integrity Sharing and access issues Support Share Point, Microsoft Teams, and One Drive integration for project collaboration. Investigate synchronization and document access issues involving One Drive and Share Point. Support Share Point storage, quota, and site health-related activities. Assist with Share Point governance and configuration standards.
2. Power Platform Support & Governance Provide operational support for: Power Apps Power Automate Power BI from a support and administration perspective Support business solutions used for: Project tracking Approval workflows Site operations Reporting and dashboards Business process automation Diagnose and resolve: Power Automate flow failures Connector issues Authentication and connection problems Data source errors Permission issues Power Apps performance and usability issues Power BI refresh and access issues Monitor and troubleshoot Power Platform environments and solutions. Support controlled enhancements, configuration changes, and minor fixes within governed environments. Ensure compliance with: Power Platform environment strategy Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies Naming conventions Connector governance Solution ownership standards Environment and application lifecycle standards Support escalation of complex Power Platform issues to relevant SMEs or Microsoft Support.
3. Incident, Problem & Change Management Operate within client-aligned ITIL service management processes, including: Incident Management Service Request Management Problem Management Change Management Provide timely resolution of incidents and service requests in accordance with agreed SLAs and OLAs. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring or high-impact issues. Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and preventive actions. Coordinate with: Account and customer stakeholders Microsoft Support Share Point SMEs Power Platform SMEs Security and compliance teams Support major incident troubleshooting and technical escalations when required. Maintain accurate operational documentation, troubleshooting guides, SOPs, and knowledge articles. Ensure effective handover between shifts and support teams.
4. Security, Compliance & Governance Implement and support Microsoft 365 security and governance requirements across Share Point Online and Power Platform. Manage and troubleshoot: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Microsoft 365 groups and security groups Share Point permissions Secure sharing External collaboration Support compliance requirements related to: Data residency Data retention Information protection Access governance Data Loss Prevention Support audits, security reviews, and compliance assessments related to Microsoft 365 and Power Platform. Ensure solutions align with enterprise standards for data protection, security, risk management, and regulatory compliance. Identify security and governance risks and recommend appropriate remediation. Work with Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, and other Microsoft security/compliance services where required.
5. Stakeholder & End-User Engagement Act as a customer-facing technical resource for Share Point Online and Power Platform services. Communicate clearly and professionally with business and IT stakeholders. Provide timely communication during: Major incidents Service disruptions Planned maintenance Changes Provide functional and technical guidance to business users. Participate in: Service review meetings Operational governance forums Customer status calls Technical discussions Continuous improvement initiatives Support Microsoft 365 and Power Platform adoption initiatives Provide basic end-user training and knowledge transfer when required. Technical Skills & Experience Mandatory Technical Skills Strong experience in Share Point Online administration and operational support. Hands-on experience with: Share Point sites and site collections Lists and document libraries Permissions and sharing Metadata and content types Version history Search One Drive integration Microsoft Teams integration Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps Power Automate Power BI Experience troubleshooting: Power Automate flows Connectors Data sources Permissions Authentication Application access Good understanding of the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including: Microsoft Teams One Drive Exchange Online Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft Purview Strong understanding of: Microsoft 365 permissions Security groups RBAC Sharing controls Governance policies DLP Experience working in enterprise-scale and regulated environments. jobDescription:

Teams Policies Configure and manage Teams policies including: Messaging policies Meeting policies Calling policies App permission policies App setup policies Live event policies Update policies Voice routing policies Emergency calling policies Teams Rooms policies Perform user-level and group-level policy assignments and troubleshoot policy conflicts.

Troubleshoot: Audio/video issues Meeting connectivity Screen sharing Recording Meeting permissions Lobby settings Presenter/attendee issues Support Teams meeting policies and meeting options. Manage meeting-related features such as: Recording Transcription Captions Webinar/Events External participation Support VIP and executive meetings when required.
4. Teams Messaging & Channels Manage Teams messaging policies. Configure messaging and collaboration features. Support channel creation and membership issues. Troubleshoot Shared Channel and Private Channel access. Support external and guest collaboration. Manage features such as GIFs, stickers, memes, and messaging restrictions. Investigate message delivery and collaboration issues.
5. Teams Voice & Calling Support Microsoft Teams Phone administration. Manage: Calling policies Dial plans Voice routing Phone numbers Resource accounts Auto Attendants Call Queues Support Calling Plans, Operator Connect, and Direct Routing environments. Troubleshoot calling and PSTN issues. Work with telecom and network teams for complex voice incidents.
6. Teams Rooms & Collaboration Devices Support Microsoft Teams Rooms and Teams Rooms Pro. Monitor Teams Rooms devices through Teams Rooms Pro Management. Coordinate with AV integrators and hardware vendors. Ensure meeting rooms remain operational and up to date.
7. Teams Applications Manage Teams applications through the Teams Admin Center. Configure app permission and setup policies. Control first-party and third-party Teams applications. Investigate application installation and access issues. Support Teams app deployment and governance. Work with Security teams to validate application permissions.
8. External & Guest Access Configure and troubleshoot: External access Guest access Shared channels Cross-tenant collaboration Investigate external user authentication and access issues. Work with Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access teams where required. Ensure external collaboration follows organizational security policies.
9. Monitoring & Troubleshooting Monitor Teams service health and user experience. Use Microsoft Teams Admin Center reporting and analytics. Analyze Teams usage and service reports. Troubleshoot complex L2/L3 issues involving: Teams client Meetings Calling Messaging Channels Authentication Network connectivity Share Point/One Drive integration Collect Teams logs and diagnostic information. Use Power Shell for advanced troubleshooting and administration. Escalate Microsoft product issues to Microsoft Support when required.
10. Microsoft 365 Integration Strong understanding of Teams integration with: Exchange Online Share Point Online One Drive Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft Purview Microsoft Defender Microsoft 365 Groups Microsoft 365 Apps Troubleshoot dependencies between Teams and underlying Microsoft 365 services.
11. Security & Governance Implement Teams governance and security standards. Support Microsoft Purview requirements related to Teams. Support: Retention policies DLP policies e Discovery Sensitivity labels Audit Ensure Teams configurations comply with organizational security requirements. Review and remediate excessive external/guest access. Maintain appropriate administrative access using RBAC/PIM.
12. Incident, Request, Change & Problem Management Handle L2/L3 Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems. Support Major Incident Management. Perform root-cause analysis for recurring Teams issues. Maintain SLA/OLA compliance. Create and maintain knowledge articles and SOPs. jobDescription: Job Description: Key Responsibilities AI Agents & Gen AI Solution Development Design, build, and deploy AI agents using Foundry + Studio to solve real business problems Implement core agent capabilities: Tool/function calling, multi-step planning, task decomposition Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with enterprise knowledge sources Memory patterns (session/state, long-term memory with governance) Guardrails (policy checks, prompt safety, structured outputs) Develop agent workflows integrating: APIs, databases, event-driven services, internal tools Approval loops, HITL (Human-in-the-Loop), and escalation handling Data & Knowledge Integration Build and optimize RAG pipelines: Document ingestion, chunking, embedding strategies Vector search Grounding, citations, and source traceability Connect enterprise data sources in AI Foundry (datasets, ontology/semantic models where applicable) and operationalize for agent usage. Engineering Excellence (Production Readiness) Create evaluation frameworks for Gen AI: Automated tests for factuality/grounding, relevance, toxicity, refusal correctness Offline + online evaluation, regression testing for prompts and agent tools Implement observability: Agent traces, tool-call logs, latency/cost metrics, failure modes Ensure security, compliance, and governance: Access control, secrets management, PII handling Model usage policies, auditability, and change management Collaboration & Delivery Partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into agent designs and deliver measurable outcomes. Contribute to reusable libraries, templates, and best practices for Foundry/Studio agent development. jobDescription:
Job Description: Key Responsibilities includes:
1. Team Leadership & Development Lead, mentor, and manage a team comprising Process Associates and SME. Monitor individual and team performance, offering regular coaching and support to enhance productivity and quality. Foster a positive, motivated, and engaged team environment.
2. Operational Management Ensure consistent adherence to client-defined SLAs, KPIs, and contractual obligations. Manage escalations, resolve client and customer concerns, and address overpayment issues promptly. Conduct regular performance evaluations and monthly one-on-one sessions. Bring hands-on experience in managing process migrations and system conversions.
3. Process Optimization Identify gaps and opportunities for process improvement and efficiency. Collaborate closely with quality, training, and workforce management teams to drive continuous improvement. Support automation and digitization initiatives wherever applicable.
4. Reporting & Insights Prepare and analyse daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports. Share actionable insights and strategic recommendations with senior leadership and clients. Track and report key metrics such as team performance, attrition, and attendance.

6. Agency & Producer Solution Management Oversee end-to-end agency and producer administration activities, including agent onboarding, maintenance of licensing and appointment records, profile updates, and compliance with carrier and regulatory requirements. Manage commission-related operations such as validating commission setups, coordinating payout accuracy, investigating discrepancies, and resolving producer inquiries within defined turnaround times. Drive process governance and service excellence by monitoring workflow accuracy, partnering with internal and onshore stakeholders on escalations, and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, controls, and producer experience. title: Integral Technical Architect
jobDescription: Job Description: Job Profile/Key Responsibilities Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership Define and own end-to-end solution architecture for enterprise applications. Design high-performance, scalable, secure, resilient, and cloud-native solutions on AWS, as well as modernize and optimize monolithic applications. Establish architecture standards, design principles, best practices, and governance processes across the SDLC. Create and maintain architecture artifacts, including HLDs, LLDs, sequence diagrams, deployment diagrams, integration designs, and technical roadmaps. Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure compliance with organizational standards and obtain architecture approvals. Evaluate and recommend architecture patterns, frameworks, tools, and technology stacks aligned with business and technical objectives. Mentor engineering teams, technical leads, and developers, fostering engineering excellence and architectural best practices. Participate in strategic technology planning, modernization initiatives, and transformation programs. Work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and clients to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Present architectural solutions, conduct technical workshops, and lead architecture review sessions. Define and enforce security architecture standards, secure design principles, and compliance requirements across applications and platforms. Conduct architecture and security reviews to identify risks, vulnerabilities, and mitigation strategies. Ensure solutions adhere to security best practices including authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, auditability, and data protection. Collaborate with Enterprise Security and Compliance teams to ensure alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements. Application & Cloud Architecture Lead solution design and implementation using Java/JEE, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven architectures. Define reusable frameworks, components, design patterns, and engineering standards. Drive application modernization initiatives, including migration from monolithic architectures to microservices and cloud-native platforms. Design and implement AWS-based solutions leveraging services such as ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, RDS, Dynamo DB, Elasti Cache, S3, Cloud Front, IAM, Cloud Watch, and Secrets Manager. Architect containerized solutions using Docker, ECS/EKS, and Kubernetes. Define cloud migration strategies, disaster recovery plans, capacity management, cost optimization approaches, and operational excellence practices. Design secure-by-default applications and cloud platforms leveraging AWS security services and best practices. Architect identity and access management solutions using IAM roles, policies, federated authentication, and least-privilege access principles. Define security controls for APIs, microservices, containers, databases, and cloud infrastructure. Implement encryption strategies for data at rest and in transit using AWS KMS, Secrets Manager, TLS, and related security services. Ensure cloud solutions meet security, compliance, availability, scalability, and disaster recovery requirements. Guide teams on secure coding practices and remediation of security vulnerabilities identified through scans, audits, and penetration testing. Performance Engineering & Operational Excellence Provide subject matter expertise in performance engineering, monitoring, tuning, diagnostics, and capacity planning. Analyze and resolve complex performance and scalability challenges, including multi-threading and concurrent processing issues. Utilize performance monitoring and diagnostic tools such as Dynatrace, JProfiler, Visual VM, Glowroot, and similar APM solutions. Evaluate emerging performance engineering methodologies, monitoring tools, and technologies, and promote best practices across teams. Delivery & Stakeholder Management Drive software development lifecycle activities, including requirements analysis, solution design, implementation, and delivery. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders in a fast-paced Agile environment. Support project planning, estimation, risk management, and technical decision-making. Demonstrate excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Required Skills Java (Core Java, Java EE/Jakarta EE) Spring Boot & Spring Framework Microservices Architecture REST APIs / JSON Services Angular AWS Cloud Services Docker, ECS/EKS, Kubernetes Oracle, SQL Server Mongo DB / Amazon Document DB SQL & Database Design JProfiler, Visual VM, Glowroot, Dynatrace (preferred) JBoss, Tomcat Multi-threading & Performance Tuning Agile / Scrum Application Security AWS Security Desired Skills AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) Insurance / BFSI Domain Experience Cloud Migration & Modernization Experience Event-Driven Architecture (Kafka/SQS/SNS) Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / Cloud Formation) At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. title: Sr Analyst I Business Process Transactions
jobDescription:
Job Description: Essential Job Functions: • India Tax Law Knowledge: Possess in-depth knowledge of India’s tax laws, including GST and TDS and apply them effectively to the accounts payable process. • TDS Return Filing and Preparation of Audit Statements: Manage the preparation and timely filing of TDS returns on a quarterly basis, ensuring accuracy in tax deductions and payments. Assist in preparing audit statements and documentation required for internal and external audits. • Tax Audits & Assessments: Assist with tax audits and assessments, providing necessary documentation and clarifications as required by tax authorities. • Submission of Tax Filings: Ensure timely submission of tax-related documents, returns, and statements, minimizing the risk of penalties or non-compliance. • Invoice Verification & Processing: Ensure timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices, ensuring compliance with the company’s policies and approval processes. • Payment Processing: Process payments to vendors and suppliers according to agreed terms, ensuring that all payments are accurately recorded in the accounts payable ledger. • Discrepancy Resolution: Identify and resolve any discrepancies between purchase orders, invoices, and payments, liaising with vendors and internal teams as needed. • Vendor Record Maintenance: Maintain up-to-date vendor information and ensure the proper documentation for each transaction. • Accrual Management: Manage accrual accounting entries for expenses and liabilities related to accounts payable, ensuring accurate month-end close processes. • Reconciliation of Accruals: Ensure that accruals are properly recorded, reconciled, and aligned with the financial statements during period-end reporting. • Financial Statement Preparation: Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements by providing accurate accounts payable and accrual information. • Internal Control: Ensure compliance with internal controls, company policies, and statutory requirements related to accounts payable and tax filing processes. • Process Efficiency: Identify and recommend improvements to accounts payable processes, leveraging technology and automation tools to enhance efficiency and accuracy. Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent combination of education and experience • Typically, 6-10 years of experience in accounts payable, with a deep understanding of India tax laws and statutory regulations. • Hands-on experience in preparing business income tax returns and statements for audits. • Strong knowledge and experience in TDS return filing and GST return compliance. • Proficiency in accounting software such as SAP. • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, etc.). • Familiarity with tax filing software and online tax portals (e.g., GSTN, Income Tax Portal). • Experience with accrual accounting and financial reporting. Other

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and compliance. • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. • Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with internal and external stakeholders, including tax authorities. • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. • Strong organizational and time management skills to meet deadlines, particularly during tax filing seasons. • Tax Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of Indian Taxation (GST, TDS, Income Tax) and related statutory regulations. • Deadline-Driven: Ability to manage multiple priorities and adhere to tight deadlines, especially during peak tax seasons. • Confidentiality: Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive financial information with confidentiality and professionalism. • Process Improvement Mindset: Eagerness to identify areas for improvement and drive process enhancements within the accounts payable and tax compliance areas. • Advanced degree in a relevant field a plus • Relevant certifications (e.g., Six Sigma, PMP) or significant relevant work experience a plus At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. jobDescription:
Job Description: Overview The Data‑Literate Business Analyst will play a pivotal role in transforming complex, large‑scale data into meaningful insights, clear visual narratives, and actionable business requirements. This role sits at the intersection of data analysis, business problem‑solving, and data product development. You’ll work closely with data engineers, product teams, and senior stakeholders to ensure that data is understood, trusted, and used to drive strategic decisions. Key Responsibilities Data Analysis & Interpretation Perform extensive data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation across large and complex datasets. Analyse structured and unstructured data to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and root causes. Apply statistical and analytical techniques to validate findings and support evidence‑based decision‑making. Investigate data quality issues, quantify their impact, and support remediation planning. Data Visualisation & Reporting Develop compelling data visualisations, dashboards, and graphical outputs using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar. Translate analytical findings into clear, executive‑level reporting that supports strategic conversations and decision‑making. Present insights in a way that is accessible to both technical and non‑technical audiences. Requirements Gathering & Data Product Development Convert analytical insights into well‑structured business and functional requirements for data products, data models, and reporting solutions. Collaborate with data engineering and architecture teams to shape data pipelines, data models, and metadata requirements. Define acceptance criteria, user stories, and process flows that reflect the needs uncovered through data analysis. Support the design and prioritisation of data quality remediation activities, ensuring alignment with business value. Stakeholder Engagement Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring clarity, alignment, and shared understanding. Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and data deep‑dives to uncover business needs and data‑driven opportunities. Communicate complex data concepts in a clear, concise, and influential manner. Skills & Experience Essential Strong proficiency in data manipulation using SQL, Python, Excel, or similar tools. Demonstrated ability to work with large, complex datasets and derive meaningful insights. Advanced data visualisation skills with experience producing executive‑ready dashboards and reports. Proven experience translating analytical findings into business requirements for data products or data‑driven solutions. Solid understanding of data models, data architecture concepts, and data quality principles. Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and challenge constructively. Basic

jobDescription: Job Description: BA/QA Lead – Smart Apps | JL8 BA/QA Lead DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) empowers global companies to operate their mission-critical systems and operations while modernizing IT, optimizing data architectures, and ensuring security and scalability across public, private, and hybrid clouds. Many of the world’s largest companies and public sector organizations trust DXC to deliver exceptional service across the Enterprise Technology Stack, driving performance, competitiveness, and customer experience. Discover more about our commitment to excellence for customers and colleagues at DXC.com. At DXC, we harness the power of technology to deliver essential IT services that help our clients modernize operations and drive innovation across their entire IT infrastructure. Our services span the Enterprise Technology Stack and include business process outsourcing, analytics and engineering, applications, security, cloud, IT outsourcing, and modern workplace solutions. Our DXC Assure Smart Apps help clients to modernize and automate enterprise workflows for Insurance Software and Business Processing Services. Leveraging the full capabilities of the Service Now platform, we deliver end-to-end digital transformation solutions that improve service delivery, enhance user experience, and drive operational efficiency. Role Summary We are looking for a senior BA/QA Lead – Smart Apps with around 15 years of overall experience, including strong exposure to business analysis, QA leadership, delivery, and stakeholder management in the insurance domain. This role will own business requirement quality, end-to-end test governance, release readiness, UAT coordination, and quality outcomes across Smart Apps / Insurance initiatives. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, development teams, QA teams, and other cross-cutting teams to ensure high-quality, low-risk delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead BA and QA activities across Smart Apps / Insurance releases, from requirement discovery to production validation. Own requirement quality, including business process understanding, user stories, acceptance criteria, traceability, and requirement sign-offs. Drive test automation adoption using automation tools to improve coverage and efficiency. Own defect governance, including triage, prioritization, root-cause discussions, reporting, and closure tracking. Ensure end-to-end traceability from requirements to test cases, defects, and release readiness. Partner with Solution Architects / Tech Leads to review solution impacts, integration dependencies, and data quality risks. Manage business, product owner, client, and delivery stakeholder communication, including readiness updates and sign-offs. Provide quality metrics, dashboards, risk insights, and executive-level updates to leadership. Drive proactive risk identification and mitigation related to scope, quality, dependencies, data, timelines, and release readiness. Mentor BA/QA team members and promote ownership, domain depth, automation mindset, and continuous improvement. Promote AI adoption, automation, efficiency improvements, and continuous learning within the team. Support major releases, upgrades, production validations, and post-release quality reviews. Required Skills & Experience Around 15 years of experience in BA/QA, delivery quality, testing, or business process roles. Good understanding of insurance business processes, such as policy servicing, claims, customer servicing, case management, and operational workflows. Ability to lead both: Business Analysis – requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria. Quality Assurance – test strategy, execution governance, automation, release sign-off and UAT coordination. Experience in Agile / Scrum delivery models. Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to work across business, technology, QA, and leadership teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and decision-making skills. Experience managing delivery risks, and release-level quality outcomes. Nice to have Skills Experience in Service Now delivery, preferably across CSM, Insurance, or Financial Services workflows. Service Now configurations, customizations, workflows, integrations, case flows, catalog items, portals, and data changes. title: Finance Audit & Compliance Senior Analyst II
jobDescription:
Job Description:

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Oversee staff auditors (both internal staff and external co-source resources). Perform and/or review targeted risk assessments to determine scope of audit projects. Perform process walk-throughs to facilitate the development of the audit scope and approach during the planning phase. Prepare corresponding engagement request lists and other key planning documents. Determine, perform and/or review data analytics for the relevant areas as available and identify outliners / key focus areas for testing of internal controls. Execute/conduct financial regulatory, and operational audits, which includes the testing of internal controls and business-related processes. Specifically: Act as a key liaison with stakeholders, DXC management and external auditors throughout the audit process. Contribute to the design of the control testing approach and related audit program. Re-confirm/update process walkthroughs as needed. Identify, analyze, and interpret data using statistical techniques to recognize trends or patterns in complex data sets. Provide leadership to and supervision of other auditors participating in the project. Provide training of and feedback to less experienced auditors on the engagement. Monitor audit progress to ensure completion within allotted timeframes. Identify areas/processes for improvement and propose recommendations. Draft reports of audit findings and obtain management responses in accordance with the functions KPIs and procedures. Follow up on remediation efforts related to such findings. Document testing results in the reporting tool. Actively participate in special projects. Job Requirements: Actively participate in special projects. title: ServiceNow Technical Lead
jobDescription: Job Description: As a Service Now Technical Lead, You will be the primary technical executor delivering insurance workflow solutions on Service Now FSO. You will lead development, manage code migration and release cycles, drive automation through Flow Designer and Playbooks, and mentor junior developers — all within a practice building custom insurance applications spanning claims processing, billing integration, policy servicing, AI document processing, and compliance automation. This role requires a seasoned professional with deep Service Now development experience, strong understanding of platform upgrade cycles, and proven ability to review, refactor, and migrate code into stable production environments. You will also guide teams through technical best practices, platform governance, and continuous improvement efforts. ________________________________________ Key Responsibilities • Support the design, development, and implementation of scalable Service Now solutions aligned with client requirements and platform best practices. • Review and refactor submitted code, ensuring quality, performance, and maintainability across modules and custom applications. • Manage the end-to-end migration of code and configurations from development to production environments. • Participate in platform upgrades, patching, and release activities, ensuring minimal disruption and optimal performance. • Collaborate with architects, administrators, and business analysts to define requirements and implement solutions using Service Now native tools. • Drive automation through Flow Designer, Playbooks, and Automated Test Framework (ATF). • Ensure adherence to coding standards, security guidelines, and compliance requirements. • Mentor and guide junior developers, promoting a culture of technical excellence. • Support continuous improvement initiatives across development, testing, and deployment processes. ________________________________________ Required Skills & Experience • 8–10 years of overall experience in Service Now design, development, and implementation. • Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification is required. • Strong hands-on experience with Service Now architecture, scripting (Java Script/Glide), and system design. • Proven track record of migrating Service Now applications from development to production and supporting platform releases, and version management. • Demonstrated ability to analyze, refactor, and modernize legacy Service Now codebases. ________________________________________ Must-Have Service Now Knowledge or Micro-Certification in at least one of the following areas: • Customer Service Management (CSM) (Must Have) • Playbooks • Flow Designer • UI Builder • Now Assist / AI • Platform Analytics • Predictive Intelligence • Service Portal • Catalog Items • Automated Test Framework (ATF) ________________________________________ Preferred Qualifications • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. • Experience with Agile or Dev Ops methodologies for Service Now delivery. • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and source control (e.g., Git, Jenkins). • Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills. • Ability to work collaboratively with distributed teams across time zones. Service Now FSO experience is strongly preferred. We will consider candidates with equivalent depth in: • BPM platform developers: Strong process orchestration, case management, and integration depth that maps well to Service Now Flow Designer and FSO. • Insurance platform developers: Deep insurance workflow knowledge from enterprise platforms, with willingness to upskill on Service Now. • Full-stack developers with BPM exposure: React/Angular front-end plus back-end API/integration experience in financial services or insurance. Insurance domain knowledge — claims lifecycle, policy administration, billing, compliance — is a significant differentiator. Business process optimization experience is a plus. ________________________________________ Nice to have skills & experience • Experience with intelligent document processing or AI document classification integrated within Service Now workflows. • Familiarity with insurance compliance requirements: state DOI regulations, OFAC, AML, escheatment. • Knowledge of Now Assist and Generative AI capabilities within Service Now. Experience in multi-instance, multi-tenant Service Now environments. ________________________________________ Work Environment & Expectations • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, standard business hours. • May require occasional support during critical upgrades or production releases. • Opportunity to collaborate with global DXC teams across architecture, delivery, and support functions At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success.
